text:
The response fulfills the basic requirement of introducing a character who discovers time-travel abilities, but it falls short of being "intriguing" as requested. It relies heavily on telling rather than showing ("strange and unsettling feeling," "confusion and wonder"), uses clichéd phrases ("fateful morning," "rubbed her tired eyes"), and contains a jarring shift to second person ("the world around you") that disrupts the narrative voice. Most critically, it lacks concrete sensory details or a specific inciting incident that would hook the reader—instead, it abstractly states the premise without mystery or tension.

Rating: [[3]]
